content.text:
I've submitted **index 6** (In 0.79, Sb 0.21) as the best composition, with a measured EQE of **0.040%**. All three EQE efficiencies were very low, and with only three samples it's unclear whether index 6 is close to the library's best.

| Index | In / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.87 / 0.13 | 0.017 |
| **6** | **0.79 / 0.21** | **0.040** |
| 22 | 0.27 / 0.73 | 0.025 |

**Why these three:**
- **XRD:** index 6 was the only one of three scanned films (6, 15, 20) with a crystalline oxide. Its pattern looks like In₂O₃ or the In₁₁Sb₃O₂₄ phase, though the fit was weak (best match 0.37). Indexes 15 and 20 showed a few peaks, most at the same positions as index 6, but matched no known phase (all scores 0.06 or below). That's consistent with the Sb-rich films being amorphous.
- **Band gaps (predicted):** In₁₁Sb₃O₂₄ is about 1.9 eV and In₂O₃ about 2.2 eV, both below the 2.7 eV light, so they should absorb. In₃Sb₅O₁₂ is about 2.8 eV, right at the edge. The stability model puts In₁₁Sb₃O₂₄ and InSbO₄ on the stability limit, with In₃Sb₅O₁₂ just above it.
- **Measurement order:** index 6 first, then index 22 on the Sb-rich side to test the other end. After index 22 came in lower, I tried the most In-rich film, index 0, which came in lower still.

**Main gap:** 18 of 28 compositions, including the whole middle of the range (indexes 10–19), were never measured for EQE. A better composition there, or between indexes 1 and 5, can't be ruled out. Two of the five XRD scans were also left unused.
